entities.summary: Pedro de Mendoza, a notable figure in the history of Argentina, associated with Inca Expansion and Early European Contact (1516–1580). Preceded by Díaz de Solís reaches Río de la Plata and Incas. Their legacy influenced First founding of Buenos Aires by Mendoza — 1536 (abandoned) and Juan de Garay re-founds Buenos Aires.
